title: Simultaneous non-vanishing of Dirichlet L-functions
summary: In this paper, we prove the simultaneous non-vanishing of four Dirichlet $L$-functions at any point on the critical line. More precisely, let $χ_1,\ldots,χ_4$ be even Dirichlet characters modulo $D_1,\ldots, D_4$ respectively, where the $D_j$ are pairwise co-prime and square-free integers. Under the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, we prove that $\prod_{j=1}^4 L(1/2+it,χχ_j) \neq 0$ for a positive proportion of Dirichlet characters $χ\pmod q$, with $q$ prime and sufficiently large in terms of the $D_j$ and $t$ (and with an explicit relationship between $D_j, t$ and $q$).
